title: Model-dependent incremental value of RR recurrence determinism in AFDB-to-LTAFDB transfer
abstract: In exploratory AFDB-to-LTAFDB external evaluation, RR recurrence determinism changed equal-record log loss by 0.00297560; source-refit/target-record bootstrap95% interval [-0.00971, 0.03710] does not establish primary-model benefit. A registered forest diagnostic improves log loss by0.00540, but its post-hoc target-only interval excludes source-training uncertainty. Source2687 windows/25recordings; target17623windows/83eligible recordings. External exploratory evaluation, not untouched confirmation. Existing-public-data analysis; AI-authored; author checks are not peer review.
